work.author: Questa lettera del Pontefice Massimo di Roma, successore dis. Pietro, @ mandata
work.description: Letter CXI, printed in Italian, answers Dejazmach Wube, lord of Tigre, on reunion in faith and sends gifts; its own superscription LF24509–24512 (“Questa lettera del Pontefice Massimo di Roma, successore dis. Pietro, @ mandata a Desgiamaccio Ubie …”), body and dating clause “Dato in Roma dal palazzo apostolico Quirinale questo di 29 agosto 1841” survive. Its provenance note1 is LF24640 at the foot of leaf 181. Issuer evidence: Questa lettera del Pontefice Massimo di Roma, successore dis. Pietro, @ mandata at LF24509–24510; the source dating clause at LF24546–24548 reads: Dato in Roma dal palazzo apostolico Qui- rinale questo di 29 agosto 1841, anno del No- stro pontificato undecimo. The printing gives no GREGORIUS PP. XVI. intitulation; the letter’s own Italian superscription naming the Roman Pontiff as sender is retained as its address and supplies the issuer. The text language is Italian, not Latin. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
